rounds.text: Prithvi Exchange (India) Ltd is significantly undervalued by the market, trading at a steep discount with its price sitting just 12% up its 52-week range [E5] and lagging near its lows [E46, E48]. A disciplined discounted cash flow valuation estimates intrinsic value at Rs 149 per share compared to the current market price of Rs 102, creating an attractive margin of safety of 31.4% [E43, E44]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF implies a modest 12.8% earnings growth rate against an expected 18.0% base case, meaning the market is penalising the stock too harshly for short-term cyclical dips while ignoring its exceptional long-term compound growth of 84% over 10 years and 38% over 5 years [E14, E15, E45]. The company maintains pristine financial health with a nearly debt-free balance sheet, boasting a low debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.09x [E38, E57]. This conservative capital structure is complemented by strong operational momentum backed by a supportive Financial Services sector tailwind score of up to +0.86 [E68] and solid historical compounding where 5-year and 3-year share price growth reached 32% and 16% respectively [E23, E24]. Conceded: [E21, E25, E34, E35, E36, E63].
